name: Healing Potion
description: A small vial of glowing red liquid. When consumed, heal 1d8 hit points.

name: Rope (50 ft)
description: A sturdy hempen rope, useful for climbing, binding, or securing objects.

name: Torch
description: A wooden torch that provides bright light in a close radius for one hour.

name: Lockpicking Tools
description: A set of fine metal picks and tension wrenches used to open locks.

name: Adventurer's Pack
description: A sturdy backpack containing bedroll, rations, waterskin, flint and steel, and a small knife.

name: Mysterious Gemstone
description: A dark gemstone that pulses faintly with an inner light. Its purpose is unknown.

name: Antidote
description: A small vial of bitter liquid that neutralizes most common poisons when consumed.

name: Map Fragment
description: A torn piece of parchment showing part of an unfamiliar region. Could lead to treasure or danger.
